q: A dice is thrown. What is the probability of getting a number greater than 4?
Two dice are thrown together. What is the probability of getting a total of 9?
In a standard dice, which number is opposite to 3?
exp: Standard dice: opposite pairs are (1,6), (2,5), (3,4). Answer: 4

q: A dice is thrown twice. What is the probability of getting the same number both times?
A dice is thrown. What is the probability of getting an even number?
Two dice are thrown. What is the probability of getting a sum of 7?
Two dice are thrown. What is the probability of getting a product of 12?
Two dice are thrown. What is the probability of getting a sum of at least 10?
Two dice are thrown. What is the probability of getting a product of 6?
A dice is thrown twice. What is the probability that the second number is greater than the first?
Three dice are thrown together. What is the probability of getting a total of 10?
exp: Number of ways to get sum 10 with 3 dice = 27; total outcomes = 216; probability = 27/216 = 1/8. Answer: 1/8

q: Two dice are thrown. Given that at least one shows 1, what is the probability that the other also shows 1?
exp: Outcomes with at least one 1: 11; both 1: 1; probability = 1/11. Answer: 1/11

q: Two dice are thrown. What is the probability of getting a difference of 2?
A dice is thrown twice. What is the probability that the sum is even and the first number is odd?
exp: Sum even requires both odd or both even; first odd + both odd: (1,1),(1,3),(1,5),(3,1),(3,3),(3,5),(5,1),(5,3),(5,5) = 9; probability = 9/36 = 1/4. Answer: 1/4
